about: Where Find Bingo listings come from, state by state: every statewide source we know, whether it is loaded, and what to do next. Organizer pages already used are counted from the lists themselves (docs/BINGO-COVERAGE.md). Hand-maintained; checked by scripts/bingo_pipeline.py.

evidence_levels.state_schedule: A state regulator's list that gives each game's day and time.
evidence_levels.organizer_schedule: The group's own published schedule: its website, lodge or post page, or a city or senior-center calendar.
evidence_levels.state_license: A state list of licensed groups or permitted places, without game days.

organizer_networks.name: Elks lodges
organizer_networks.how: Lodge events by state (change State=); it shows each lodge's next few events, so search the page for "bingo", then confirm on the lodge's own page. Read in a browser: the host refuses scripted downloads from this environment.

organizer_networks.name: Fraternal Order of Eagles aeries
organizer_networks.how: Aerie pages and state Eagles associations; many games are for members and guests only, which we leave out.

organizer_networks.name: Loyal Order of Moose lodges
organizer_networks.how: Lodge pages and calendars; check whether the game is open to the public.

organizer_networks.name: Catholic parishes and Knights of Columbus councils
organizer_networks.how: Parish bulletins and council pages; keep only a current, dated schedule.

organizer_networks.name: Volunteer fire companies
organizer_networks.how: Company websites; strong in Pennsylvania, New York and New England.

sources.label: Wisconsin Department of Administration: Active Bingo Occasion Search
sources.note: Every licensed occasion with group, place, street address, ZIP, date and start time. Read in a browser (the shell proxy refuses the host), saved as a CSV, then turned into weekly patterns by the importer. Search by organization-name letters; a blank filter is refused. Nov 23 read: 2916 occasions, 11/24/2026 to 12/21/2027.

states.next: Rerun the importer every 180 days, or sooner once the state posts the next year's occasions. Groups that hold one-off nights are left out by design.
